statistical_unit: allocation x workload x offered_rate x seed; requests are not independent repeats

statistical_method.primary_endpoint: paired goodput_req_s at each predeclared TTFT threshold with TPOT <= 200 ms
statistical_method.ci: two-sided 95% Student t interval on three paired seed differences (df=2)
statistical_method.effect_size: Cohen dz = mean paired difference / paired SD
statistical_method.multiple_comparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg within the 180-test primary goodput family; secondary metric families corrected separately
statistical_method.timing_metrics: reported descriptively; no wall-clock reproducibility comparison

fallacy_scan.detail: All primary comparisons stay stratified by workload and offered rate; pooled directions are not used as the sole result.
The inferential unit is the paired seed/trace cell, not an individual request; request counts only form cell metrics.
The evidence is conditional on one model, one RTX 5090, and the frozen load grid; external deployment prevalence is not inferred.
No post-treatment queue, latency, or success variable is conditioned on when forming paired differences.
All 320,400 offered measurement requests remain in denominators and failures are counted as SLO misses.
Confirmatory seeds 11/23/47 were frozen before this run and were not selected by observed outcomes.
All 144 cells are retained and the audit fails closed on missing or failed cells; observed failure count is zero.
180 primary goodput tests plus secondary metrics and five thresholds are reported; BH-FDR is applied within the declared primary family.
The formal matrix is frozen, but launcher provenance is incomplete; the gap is disclosed rather than repaired retrospectively.
Allocation is controlled, but environment-sensitive serving measurements do not by themselves identify a mechanism or universal causal benefit.
Precision allocation is assigned before each cold-start serving epoch, so latency cannot determine the assignment retrospectively.

reproducibility.reason: This attempt is structurally complete, but Gate 4 requires comparison against a separate environment-sensitive formal attempt.
